primary: Frozen direct T controls throughout the 0.32s interval and afterwards.
alternate: Highest neural score in a different jump/dash/downward-cast class among currently feasible alternatives. Use that complete native key at onset; for the remainder of 0.32s retain its horizontal and jump-hold intent, allowing fresh jump/dash/cast pulses only when also requested by T. Then resume T.
risk_trigger: Top training quartile of a frozen risk readout on T features; 0.72s prediction of a native HP loss; vulnerable trio only.
fit: Cross-fit ridge outcome regressions by training fight. Fit one conservative linear contrast on the frozen T representation to choose between the two exact options. Same schedule, neural readouts and option decoder in the executable.
screen: On six held fights require positive fight-mean four-second observed reward and positive in at least four fights against T; estimated lost native masks lower, eight-second measured reward nonnegative. No learned continuation in either outcome. Report terminal counts separately.

action_world_study.method: Learn two 8-step latent native-action motion models and two action-blind body/disc box fields at 0.16 and 0.32s. Read both option trajectories in the same field from each onset. Distill XY, vulnerability and separate body/disc contact contrasts at both horizons into a 10-column projection of the frozen native encoder. Use randomized real rewards to fit the switch. No observational immediate damage predictor selects actions.
action_world_study.selection: World weights and feature projection use old development training trajectories only. In held, actually randomized, four-key descent trials require lower assigned-arm than swapped-arm horizontal-error mean and in a majority of at least four held games. For the newer 24 compound games, fit only 18 designated train games. On six previously designated holdout games require positive four-second reward in >=4 games and on average, a majority with fewer actual masks and lower mean masks, nonnegative mean eight-second reward and nonnegative four- and eight-second boss output. Fresh 100-fight original conditions are the final acceptance. Keep the previously registered random-projection controller as a separate comparison; the six development games are shared.
action_world_study.historical_behavior: The descent randomizer used H. Verify its frozen native export against the original actor checksum before interpreting either randomized arm. Predict H logits for the continuation in the old held experiment. Use T for the later compound experiment.
